facts.fact: Starlink launched in Kenya in 2023 and distributes hardware and connects users through third parties and resellers; the article says CA data shows Starlink users grew tenfold in Q1 2024 (no figure given), and a $10 monthly plan and, from 21 August 2024, a $15 kit-rental plan were offered.

note: Safaricom memo asking CA to bar unlicensed-local satellite ISPs is a proposal, not a fact; CA count is cited without a number.
